title: Price Adjustment Terms by Channel: Northgate Purchases & Returns
content:
Northgate Purchases & Returns credits a member the difference when the price of an item already bought drops. The terms below set, for each channel, how long that protection lasts and which prices and lines it covers.

| Channel | Price adjustment window (calendar days after the fulfillment date) | Adjustments allowed per sale line | Classes never price-adjusted |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate In-Club Purchase | 30 | 1 | gasoline; tobacco and alcohol; Shop Card and gift card |
| Northgate Club Pickup Order | 30 | 1 | gasoline; tobacco and alcohol; Shop Card and gift card |
| Northgate Same-Day Delivery Order | 0 (no price adjustments) | 0 | gasoline; tobacco and alcohol; Shop Card and gift card |
| Northgate.com Ship-to-Home Order | 30 | 1 | gasoline; tobacco and alcohol; Shop Card and gift card |
| Northgate Business Delivery Order | 30 | 1 | gasoline; tobacco and alcohol; Shop Card and gift card; grocery |
| Northgate Special Order | 0 (no price adjustments) | 0 | gasoline; tobacco and alcohol; Shop Card and gift card |

## Terms common to all six channels

| Term | Setting on every channel |
|---|---|
| Only a lower price on the same channel qualifies | yes |
| A clearance price counts as a lower price | no |
| Another retailer's price is matched | no |
| An Instant Savings promotion's member limit caps the units adjusted to its price | yes |
| How the lower price is chosen | the lowest regular or Instant Savings price in effect inside the window |
| Only units of the sale line not already refunded are adjusted | yes |

## Notes

- A window of 0 days means the channel gives no price adjustments at all; that is the case for the Northgate Same-Day Delivery Order and the Northgate Special Order.
- The Northgate Business Delivery Order additionally excludes grocery from price adjustment.

Hypothetical reading: a vacuum bought as a Northgate Club Pickup Order whose regular price on that channel drops inside 30 days qualifies; a lower price seen at another retailer, or a clearance tag, does not.
